title: Book of Dead Gods
summary: Attempt the DC 10 Religion check to obtain a Scroll of Ray of Enfeeblement even on failure. Passing also grants Acolyte inspiration.

fields.Effect: Open the book and attempt its DC 10 Religion check to obtain a Scroll of Ray of Enfeeblement even on failure. Passing also grants the Acolyte inspiration. Alternatively, lockpick it with DC 10 Sleight of Hand and then read it.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
